description: The latest accepted provider observation. Repeating the same phase and condition code returns this same snapshot and its original observation timestamp.

condition_code.description: The condition code in the latest accepted provider progress snapshot, or null. This is stored provider observation evidence, not an assertion that the condition remains effective under the current Job or Attempt lifecycle. An exact stored snapshot may be replayed after terminal state.

oneOf.description: Provider-defined lower snake-case ASCII retryable-unavailability code. It must not encode secrets, raw inputs or results, endpoint identifiers, URLs, exception text, or sensitive provider internals. This is not a heartbeat or proof that the provider process is alive.
